Blue Hour is an imported test illustration, not artwork created by Toon Pro.

The illustration was originally generated for the previous Toon Pro website
with the built-in image generation tool on 4 November 2026. It is retained here
only as a deterministic local UI and image-conversion test fixture.

blue-hour.png was decoded from the prior tracked website's blue-hour.webp
with macOS sips on 8 November 2026
because the pinned Qt SDK used for validation does not include a WebP plugin.

The drawing gallery and line-conversion screenshots contain this imported
sample artwork. Their screenshot manifests identify that distinction.
